title: Workflow pattern: webhook sms
text: Receive a webhook and send an SMS. Nodes: trigger_webhook → twilio_sms. Config: set twilio_sms.to={{trigger.body.phone}}, message={{trigger.body.message}}. Requires Twilio credentials (accountSid, authToken, fromNumber).

title: Workflow pattern: webhook email
text: Receive a webhook and send an email. Nodes: trigger_webhook → email_send. Config: to={{trigger.body.email}}, subject={{trigger.body.subject}}, body={{trigger.body.message}}. Use sendEmail or google_gmail_send node.

title: Workflow pattern: webhook slack
text: Post a Slack notification when a webhook fires. Nodes: trigger_webhook → slack_send. Config: channel="#alerts", text="New event: {{trigger.body.message}}". Requires Slack Bot Token credential.

title: Workflow pattern: webhook discord
text: Post a Discord message when a webhook fires. Nodes: trigger_webhook → discord_send. Config: webhookUrl from Discord server settings, content={{trigger.body.message}}.

title: Workflow pattern: webhook telegram
text: Send a Telegram message when a webhook fires. Nodes: trigger_webhook → telegram_send. Config: chatId={{trigger.body.chatId}}, text={{trigger.body.message}}. Requires BOT_TOKEN.

title: Workflow pattern: schedule api
text: Call an external API on a schedule. Nodes: trigger_cron → http_request. Config: cron="0 9 * * *" for daily at 9am. Set http_request.url and method.

title: Workflow pattern: schedule email report
text: Send a daily email report. Nodes: trigger_cron → http_request (fetch data) → email_send. Config: cron="0 8 * * 1-5" for weekdays 8am. Format the body with {{http_request.body}}.

title: Workflow pattern: schedule db export
text: Export database records on a schedule. Nodes: trigger_cron → postgres_query → email_send or file_write. Config: query="SELECT * FROM orders WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'".

title: Workflow pattern: ai classify route
text: Classify text with AI and branch on the result. Nodes: trigger_webhook → ai_text_classifier → logic_if. Connect the true branch to one action and false to another. Config: ai_text_classifier.categories=["urgent","normal"], logic_if checks {{ai_text_classifier.label}}.

title: Workflow pattern: gpt webhook
text: AI chatbot that responds to webhook requests. Nodes: trigger_webhook → openai_chat → respond_webhook. Config: openai_chat.prompt={{trigger.body.message}}, model="gpt-4o". Use anthropic_chat for Claude instead.

title: Workflow pattern: ai summarize email
text: Summarize content with AI then email the result. Nodes: trigger_webhook → ai_summarize → email_send. Config: ai_summarize.text={{trigger.body.content}}, email body={{ai_summarize.summary}}.

title: Workflow pattern: ai image generate
text: Generate an image with DALL-E from a prompt. Nodes: trigger_webhook → openai_dalle → respond_webhook. Config: openai_dalle.prompt={{trigger.body.prompt}}, size="1024x1024". Returns imageUrl in the response.

title: Workflow pattern: ai translate
text: Translate text using Google Translate. Nodes: trigger_webhook → google_translate → respond_webhook. Config: text={{trigger.body.text}}, target="es" for Spanish.

title: Workflow pattern: hubspot lead
text: Capture a CRM lead then notify Slack. Nodes: trigger_webhook → hubspot_contact → slack_send. Config: hubspot_contact.email={{trigger.body.email}}, firstname={{trigger.body.name}}. Slack message: "New lead: {{trigger.body.name}}".

title: Workflow pattern: stripe hubspot slack
text: On new Stripe payment, create HubSpot deal and notify Slack. Nodes: trigger_webhook → stripe_charge (verify) → hubspot_create_deal → slack_send. Map trigger.body.amount and customer email from Stripe payload.

title: Workflow pattern: monitor site
text: Monitor a website and alert on downtime. Nodes: trigger_cron → http_request → logic_if → slack_send. Config: cron="*/5 * * * *", logic_if condition: {{http_request.statusCode}} != 200, slack channel="#ops-alerts".

title: Workflow pattern: monitor db threshold
text: Alert when a database metric exceeds a threshold. Nodes: trigger_cron → postgres_query → logic_if → slack_send. Config: query counts records; logic_if checks {{postgres_query.rows[0].count}} > 1000.

title: Workflow pattern: loop email list
text: Loop over a list and send personalised emails. Nodes: trigger_webhook → loop_for_each → email_send. Config: loop_for_each.items={{trigger.body.contacts}}, email to={{$json.email}}, body="Hi {{$json.name}}".

title: Workflow pattern: sheets to slack
text: Read a Google Sheet and post a summary to Slack. Nodes: trigger_cron → google_sheets_read → ai_summarize → slack_send. Config: sheets_read.spreadsheetId and range="Sheet1!A1:Z100".

text: Parse a CSV payload and process each row. Nodes: trigger_webhook → csv_parse → loop_for_each → email_send. Config: csv_parse.data={{trigger.body.csv}}, loop items={{csv_parse.rows}}.

title: Workflow pattern: github issue slack
text: Create a GitHub issue and notify Slack. Nodes: trigger_webhook → github_issue → slack_send. Config: github_issue.title={{trigger.body.title}}, repo="owner/repo". Slack: "Issue created: {{github_issue.html_url}}".

title: Workflow pattern: s3 upload notify
text: Upload a file to S3 and notify via Slack. Nodes: trigger_webhook → aws_s3_upload → slack_send. Config: s3.bucket, s3.key={{trigger.body.filename}}, s3.body={{trigger.body.content}}.

title: Workflow pattern: vercel deploy
text: Trigger a Vercel deployment on webhook. Nodes: trigger_webhook → vercel_deploy → slack_send. Config: vercel_deploy.projectId, teamId. Notify Slack on completion.

title: Workflow pattern: error handler
text: Catch errors and alert the team. Add an error_handler node connected from any risky node. Config: error_handler.onError → slack_send with message="Workflow failed: {{error.message}}". Also use logic_retry for transient HTTP failures.

title: Workflow pattern: conditional branch
text: Branch workflow based on a condition. Nodes: trigger_webhook → logic_if → (true branch) action1 / (false branch) action2. Config: logic_if.condition="{{trigger.body.status}} === 'active'". Use logic_switch for more than two branches.

Workflow JSON contract
text:
Every generated workflow must be a JSON object with two arrays: nodes and edges.
Node shape: {"id":"n1","type":"trigger_webhook","label":"Webhook Trigger","config":{}}
Edge shape: {"id":"e1","source":"n1","target":"n2"}
Rules:
- Node ids must be unique strings (n1, n2, …).
- Every edge source and target must reference an existing node id.
- Workflows must start with a trigger node (trigger_webhook, trigger_cron, trigger_manual).
- Config values should use {{variable}} syntax for dynamic fields.
- Position is optional: {x: 250, y: 100} for React Flow layout.

title: Common node config fields
text:
Common config patterns across node types:
- HTTP nodes: url, method (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE), headers, body
- Email nodes: to, subject, body (html or text), from
- Slack nodes: channel ("#general"), text, attachments
- Database nodes: query (SQL string), params (array of values)
- Loop node: items (array expression like {{trigger.body.list}})
- AI nodes: prompt or messages, model, temperature, maxTokens
- Cron node: cron expression like "0 9 * * 1-5" = weekdays 9am
- Condition node: condition (JS-style expression), operator (equals, contains, gt, lt)

title: Credentials and secrets management
text:
Credentials are stored in the Credentials Manager (never hardcode secrets in config).
Supported credential types: OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Slack, HubSpot, Twilio, Stripe, GitHub, AWS (S3, Lambda), Google (Gmail, Sheets, Drive, Calendar, Translate, Maps), Telegram, Discord, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Airtable, Notion, Salesforce, Supabase, MongoDB.
In node config, reference credentials by name using the credential selector field.

title: Trigger nodes
text:
Every workflow must start with a trigger node. Available triggers:
- trigger_webhook: fires when an HTTP POST/GET request hits the workflow URL. Payload in {{trigger.body}}, headers in {{trigger.headers}}.
- trigger_cron: fires on a schedule. Config: cron="0 9 * * *" (daily 9am), timezone="UTC".
- trigger_manual: fires when the user clicks "Run" in the UI. Useful for testing.
- trigger_email: fires when an email arrives (IMAP polling). Config: folder="INBOX", filter by subject.
Only one trigger per workflow is typical; use logic_if to branch on payload fields.

title: Node categories overview
text:
Flowa nodes are grouped by category:
- Triggers: trigger_webhook, trigger_cron, trigger_manual, trigger_email
- HTTP/API: http_request, rest_get, rest_post, respond_webhook, graphql_query
- Messaging: email_send, slack_send, discord_send, telegram_send, twilio_sms, whatsapp_send
- AI/ML: openai_chat, anthropic_chat, ai_classify, ai_summarize, openai_dalle, whisper, google_translate, google_vision, huggingface
- Data transform: transform_set, json_parse, csv_parse, transform_split, transform_merge, transform_filter, transform_map
- Logic/Control: logic_if, logic_switch, loop_for_each, logic_delay, logic_retry, logic_parallel
- Database: postgres_query, mysql_query, supabase_query, mongodb_find, redis_command, firebase_read
- Cloud/Storage: aws_s3_upload, aws_lambda_invoke, google_drive_upload, file_read, file_write
- CRM/Productivity: hubspot_contact, hubspot_create_deal, airtable, notion, salesforce_query
- Social/Marketing: twitter_post, instagram_post, linkedin_post, reddit_post, mixpanel_track, segment_track
- Finance: stripe_charge, stripe_customer, paypal_payment
- Dev/CI: github_issue, github_pr, vercel_deploy
- Utility: code_execute, math_operation, date_time, wait_approval, console_log, error_handler
